rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for coverage given by news or other media.

example.english: This scandal has been getting a lot of coverage on TV news.
example.traditional: 呢單醜聞最近喺電視新聞有好多報道。
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 cau2 man4 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 din6 si6 san1 man4 jau5 hou2 do1 bou3 dou6

rows.note: Use this for the extent of something being covered, especially a physical or mobile-network area rather than media attention or staffing.

example.english: The mobile coverage in the subway still isn't wide enough.
example.traditional: 地鐵入面嘅手機覆蓋範圍仲未夠廣。
example.jyutping: dei6 tit3 jap6 min6 ge3 sau2 gei1 fuk1 koi3 faan6 wai4 zung6 mei6 gau3 gwong2

rows.note: Use this when coverage means having enough staff available to cover duties or shifts.

example.english: We don't have enough staff coverage for tonight's shifts, so we may not be able to cover them all.
example.traditional: 今晚更表人手唔夠，未必頂得晒啲更。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 gang3 biu2 jan4 sau2 m4 gau3 mei6 bit1 ding2 dak1 saai3 di1 gang3
